WCL Mining Sirdar, Assistant Foreman Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Western Coalfield Limited (WCL) has released the Admit Card for the post of Mining Sirdar, Assistant Foreman. This recruitment was released for 444 posts. Applications for the WCL Mining Sirdar, Assistant Foreman Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 20 July 2026, to 10 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 14 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their WCL Mining Sirdar, Assistant Foreman Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 July 2026
  • Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 14 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 11 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1180/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 0/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is WCL Mining Sirdar, Assistant Foreman Admit Card 2026?

WCL Mining Sirdar, Assistant Foreman Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
